The Analytical Engine reads strong,     
emphasis, monospace and highlighted     
text, with unconstrained marks, ©       
symbols — and a footnote.[1]            

Getting started                         

╭─ Note ───────────────────────────────╮
│ Read the whole guide before you      │
│ begin.                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────╯

Install it
                                        
 cargo install rs-rich-cli # <1>        
 rich --version            # <2>        
                                        

 <1> Installs the rich binary.          
 <2> Prints its version.
